# Motif (kevin-owens-product/5JS)

> Experimental TypeScript visualization on Three.js, with typed source adapters and example workflows linking records, evidence and decision briefs.

Working brand: Motif. Rendering import: fivejs. API: createFive and four FiveLayer factories. Connector imports: motif-connectors and motif-connectors/server. Both packages are private and unpublished; use built local paths. Node 22.12+ for the core/site, 22.16+ for connectors. Browser scenes require WebGL2. Examples use fictional data, not demonstrated customer outcomes. Unrelated to Cylynx motif.gl.
